title: The email lists every in-window service with its state; nothing beyond it
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A customer whose 'Send preventive maintenance notifications' setting is ON, with an asset that has a preferred contact carrying an email address (e.g. customer 'ZZAUTOTEST Fleet Co', unit 'Truck 12', contact 'Dave Brabay').
  3. The asset has one or more services currently inside their reminder window. Open the asset's contact card.
custom_steps:
1. On an asset with one service due today and another overdue, send the reminder.
  2. Read the email's table.
  3. Confirm it lists every service of the asset currently inside its reminder window, whatever its state.
  4. Confirm a service due in eleven months does not ride along.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • An asset with one service due today and another overdue gets one email listing both, with the state per row.
  • The email carries every service of the asset currently inside its reminder window, whatever state each one is in.
  • Nothing outside the window is included (a service due in eleven months does not ride along).
  • Each row names the unit, the service where known, when it is due and its state: Past due, Due today or Coming up.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10575 (S19, The customer reminder email (sent by hand)); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S19; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
